title: Gaussian density bound under noise
statement:
Let $\rho,x,z\in\mathbb R$ and $v>0$ satisfy $v+\rho^2=1$, and write $p_v(m,z)=(2\pi v)^{-1/2}\exp(-(z-m)^2/(2v))$. Then
\[p_v(\rho x,z)\le\left(\frac{\sqrt{2\pi}}{\sqrt{2\pi v}}\exp(x^2/2)\right)p_1(0,z).\]
hypotheses_covered: $v$ is a nonzero nonnegative real, hence $v>0$
